title: Script census configuration
description: Rules a repository supplies to python -m agentteams.script_census. No rule ships with the tool.

roots.description: Directories the inventory walks when none is named on the command line. Relative to the current directory.

snapshot_markers.description: Folder-name patterns (fnmatch) that mark a snapshot, added to the built-in ones.

family_rules.description: Tried in order; the first rule that matches names the script's family.

path.description: Regular expression searched in the script's path below its root.

content.description: Regular expression searched in the script's text, with ^ and $ matching at each line. When path is also given, both must match.

fragment_rules.description: Every rule whose pattern is found in a script's text reports one fragment for that script.

pattern.description: Regular expression searched in the script's text, with ^ and $ matching at each line.
